customManagers.description: TFE workspaces get their Terraform version from var.terraform_version; the literal lives in the variable default, so bump it there.

packageRules.description: tfe_workspace takes terraform_version from an HCL expression Renovate cannot evaluate; the real pin is handled by the custom manager above.
jdx/mise-action stays on the floating major tag (@v5) instead of a digest pin: the digest churns on every patch release and floods the PR queue.
Action and hook bumps are exercised by CI on the PR itself, so green checks are enough to merge them.
Provider and module pins land in a real plan against live infrastructure, so they get read rather than auto-merged.
